steps.says: Arrok's hunter? His word came by the coach. Here, the best ore in my stores. Do not drop it in the river.

steps.says: Ore for the blade, silk to bind the grip. A moment... there. It is yours: carry it well.

quests.name: Old Frostjaw
quests.offer:
The outpost's hunters have lost three of their own to an old snow leopard they call Frostjaw. He hunts the slopes north-east of the outpost.
Bring him down, and I will teach you what the Roost teaches its hunters at your age. Take friends from the other homes if you are wise.
Will you hunt Old Frostjaw?
quests.declined: He will not grow old enough to die on his own.
quests.started: Go with friends. He strikes first and he strikes hard.

steps.journal: Kill Old Frostjaw on the slopes north-east of the Eyrie outpost.
Return to Huntmaster Arrok.
steps.says: Frostjaw is gone? Then the outpost sleeps easier, and so do I. Learn this.

quests.name: The Heart of the Rime
quests.offer:
Something old walks in the ice caves north-east of the Eyrie outpost. The hunters call it the Rimeheart, and the cold that follows it kills the snow's game.
Break it, and carry a shard of it to Warden Halvek, so the outpost knows it is done. Then come back to me.
Will you face the Rimeheart?
quests.declined: Then the caves grow colder.
quests.started: Do not go into those caves alone.

steps.journal: Take a shard from the Rimeheart, in the ice caves north-east of the Eyrie outpost.
Bring the shard of the Rimeheart to Warden Halvek at the Eyrie outpost.
steps.says: So the Rimeheart is broken. I will send word to every home. Tell Arrok the Eyrie owes the Roost a debt.

steps.journal: Return to Huntmaster Arrok.
steps.says: Halvek's word came by the coach before you did. You have done the Roost proud. Learn this.

quests.name: The Long Watch
quests.offer:
Arrok says you are no fledgling now. A hunter of the Roost stands the long watch at the Eyrie once, so the other homes know our feathers.
Go to Warden Halvek at the Eyrie outpost and do as he asks. When it is done, come back to me, and choose your path.
Will you stand the long watch?
quests.declined: The watch waits for those who are ready.
quests.started: Fly well, and come home.

steps.journal: Find Warden Halvek at the Eyrie outpost.
steps.says: Kraawk sends you? Then you are ready for the eyrie. Scout Feyla watches it from the river's far reach: go to her.

steps.journal: Find Scout Feyla on the frozen river, north-east of the Eyrie outpost.
steps.says: The Goldfeather raiders carry their eyrie's war-talons. Bring me three, and they will think twice before they raid the river again.

steps.journal: Take three war-talons from the Goldfeather raiders round the eyrie east of the Eyrie outpost.
Bring the three war-talons to Scout Feyla.
steps.says: Three talons. The eyrie will be quiet tonight. Go home, hunter: your elder waits for you.

steps.journal: Return to Elder Kraawk in the Roost.
steps.says: You flew out a fledgling and came home a hunter of the Homelands. The Roost has one more thing to give you.

choices.says: Then it is yours.
Then it is yours.

quests.name: A Hatchling's Fang Cord
quests.offer:
So. The egg has opened, and here you stand. Good. But the Mirewatch does not know you yet, hatchling, and what the Mirewatch does not know, it spears.
Every hatchling wears the fang cord. Hidebinder Ssilith strings them, a few steps east of here.
Will you fetch your fang cord and show it to me?
quests.declined: Then wait. The swamp has time. You may not.
quests.started: East, a few steps. Ssilith is the one who smells of tanning bark.

steps.journal: Ask Hidebinder Ssilith, just east of Elder Hsslarn, for a hatchling's fang cord.
steps.says: The elder sent you. Yes. Lower your head. Reed for the cord, a gator's fang for the bite. A hatchling pays nothing. Once.

steps.journal: Show the hatchling's fang cord to Elder Hsslarn.
steps.says: It hangs well. Now the sentinels will lower their spears when you pass. Keep it at your throat.

quests.name: Bound to the Mire
quests.offer:
The swamp takes the careless, hatchling, and gives nothing back. Have Spiritmaster Thessik bind your spirit to the temple island, so that you wake here if it takes you.
Then give your name to Coachman Rassk for his ledger. His coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes of the Homelands, for those their stables know.
Will you see them both and come back to me?
quests.declined: Then step carefully. Very carefully.
quests.started: Thessik waits on the west shore. Rassk keeps his coach south-east of here, short of the east bridge.

steps.journal: Have Spiritmaster Thessik, west of the elder, bind your spirit to the temple island.
steps.says: It is done. If the swamp takes you, it must give you back, here. Now go to Coachman Rassk and give him your name.

steps.journal: Give your name to Coachman Rassk, south-east of the elder, for his ledger.
steps.says: A hatchling for the ledger. My coach runs to Freeport and to every other home of the Homelands, for travelers whose names their ledgers hold. Yours is in mine now.

steps.journal: Return to Elder Hsslarn.
steps.says:
Good. The mire knows you now, and so does the road.
Rassk's coach will carry you to Freeport if its ledger knows you, but the road I mean for you is earned. Huntmaster Kessrak, beside me, has work for you.

quests.notes: Ours (the Homelands' starter quests): the lizardman's level 2, at Cazic-Thule, on the cities' level 2 quest: the spiritmaster's bind and the coachman's ledger. quests.name: Beetles in the Reeds
quests.offer:
The hatchling. Good. Bog beetles are in the reeds on the south shore again, and they eat the eggs of everything, ours too.
Go south round the old temple to the shore, and bring me three of their shells. Then I will teach you something worth the walk.
Will you hunt them?
quests.declined: The beetles thank you. The eggs do not.
quests.started: Three shells. Strike where the wing cases meet.

steps.journal: Take three bog beetle shells from the bog beetles on the south shore of the temple island.
Bring three bog beetle shells to Huntmaster Kessrak.
steps.says: Three shells, cleanly taken. You have patience. Now watch, and learn this.

quests.name: A Hatchling's Arms
quests.offer:
Freeport pays for blades, not for claws. I will make you proper gear, but you will bring what I need.
Hidebinder Ssilith has a leather strip and a shaft for me. Then take a fang from the marsh serpents at the south end of the east island, over the bridge.
Will you bring me all three?
quests.declined: Then keep to your claws, and to the shallows.
quests.started: Leather and a shaft from Ssilith. A fang from the serpents. Go.

steps.journal: Ask Hidebinder Ssilith for the leather strip and the wooden shaft.
steps.says: For Kessrak. Yes. A strip of gator leather and a shaft of swamp ash. Tell him the next hide is mine.

steps.journal: Take a marsh serpent fang from the marsh serpents at the south end of the east island.
Bring the leather strip, the wooden shaft and the marsh serpent fang to Huntmaster Kessrak.
steps.says: All three. Wait... there. The fang sets the edge. It is yours. Keep it dry.

quests.name: Old Snapjaw
quests.offer:
One hunt more, hatchling. An old gator we call Snapjaw lies on the north shore, over the north bridge. He has taken two of our fishers, and he is not sorry.
He looks like a log until he moves, and then it is too late. Strike first. Bring me his tooth, and I will teach you the last thing I have for a hatchling.
Will you hunt Old Snapjaw?
quests.declined: He will wait. Gators are good at it. Better than you.
quests.started: North, over the bridge. Do not trust anything that floats.

steps.journal: Take Snapjaw's tooth from the alligator Old Snapjaw on the north shore, over the north bridge.
Bring Snapjaw's tooth to Huntmaster Kessrak.
steps.says:
Snapjaw's own tooth. The fishers will go north again. You are a hatchling no longer.
Learn this, and see Gatekeeper Vosskar on the east island when you are ready for Freeport.

quests.name: The Road to Freeport
quests.offer:
In Freeport the humans pay good coin for a blade that does not tire, and they ask few questions. Kessrak says yours is ready.
You have earned the road, hatchling. I will set you down among your own guild in Freeport, and your spirit will rest there.
Shall I send you to Freeport?
quests.declined: The coin will keep. So will Freeport.
quests.started: Hunt well, and send word home now and then!

steps.journal: Tell Gatekeeper Vosskar when you are ready to go to Freeport.

quests.notes: Ours: the gatekeeper's port to Freeport, the lizardman's wire race's city, each class to its own guild's spot there (teleport to mainland: the wire race's start row for the class), bound there: the passage the five starter quests earn (a coach runs between the home and Freeport for anyone). quests.name: Hides Against the Cold
quests.offer:
The homes keep a hunters' outpost on the snow under the Goldfeather Eyrie. The cold there slows our blood, hatchling. A cold Mirewatch hunter is a dead one.
Ride Rassk's coach to the Eyrie. Take two badger pelts and two clumps of rat fur from the snow east of the outpost. I will make you a warm wrap.
Will you hunt the cold snow?
quests.declined: Then stay by the warm mud a while longer.
quests.started: Keep moving out there. When your blood slows, so do you.

steps.journal: Take two snowfield badger pelts from the badgers on the snow east of the Eyrie outpost.
Take two clumps of drift rat fur from the drift rats east of the Eyrie outpost.
Bring the badger pelts and the drift rat fur to Huntmaster Kessrak.
steps.says: Thick pelts. Good. You hunted in the cold and came back with warm blood. Now learn this.

quests.notes: Ours (the Homelands' chain past the flight): the lizardman's level 7, at Cazic-Thule, on the cities' level 7 quest: two tasks of the hunt, their spoils handed in; each class is taught what its own city's level 7 quest teaches it. quests.name: A Spear That Flies True
quests.offer:
Your blade has drunk enough. It is time you carried a better one. I have the iron. What I lack are feathers for the balance.
The pale owls of the Eyrie fly the snow north of the outpost. Their pinions are long and straight. Bring me three.
Will you bring me the pinions?
quests.declined: Then your old blade must serve.
quests.started: Three pinions. Owls see well. Come at them low.

steps.journal: Take three pale owl pinions from the pale owls north of the Eyrie outpost.
Bring three pale owl pinions to Huntmaster Kessrak.
steps.says: Straight and white. Good. Iron for the bite, feather for the balance... there. It is yours. Keep it dry.

quests.name: Thinning the Cubs
quests.offer:
Word comes by the coach. The frostpaw cubs north of the Eyrie outpost have grown bold, and they take the outpost's snares and its hunters' catch.
A Mirewatch hunter thins a brood before it grows. Kill six of them, then come back to me. Hunt with the other homes if they will have you.
Will you thin the frostpaw cubs?
quests.declined: Then the cubs grow, and the snares stay empty.
quests.started: Six. They are young, not weak.

steps.journal: Kill six frostpaw cubs on the snow north of the Eyrie outpost.
Return to Huntmaster Kessrak.
steps.says: Six. The outpost's snares will fill again. You hunt like one of the Mirewatch. Learn this.

quests.name: The Cold That Walks
quests.offer:
In the ice caves north-east of the Eyrie outpost there is a thing the hunters call the Rimeheart. Where it walks, the cold grows. Our blood cannot bear it.
Break it. Take a shard to Warden Halvek, so the outpost knows it is done. Then come back to me.
Will you face the Rimeheart?
quests.declined: Then the caves grow colder, and we stay away.
quests.started: Wrap yourself well, and do not go alone.

steps.journal: Take a shard from the Rimeheart, in the ice caves north-east of the Eyrie outpost.
Bring the shard of the Rimeheart to Warden Halvek at the Eyrie outpost.
steps.says: A lizard of the Mirewatch broke the Rimeheart, in this cold? I will tell every home. Tell Kessrak the outpost owes the Mirewatch.

steps.journal: Return to Huntmaster Kessrak.
steps.says: Halvek's word came by the coach. The cold is broken, and you are still warm. Learn this, the last thing I have.

quests.name: The Watcher's Spear
quests.offer:
Kessrak says you are a hatchling no longer. Good. The Mirewatch has always kept watch. Now it keeps watch for the other homes as well.
Their scout, Feyla, watches the Goldfeather eyrie from the river north-east of their outpost. Go and lend her your spear. Then come back to me.
Will you keep the watch?
quests.declined: The watch waits. It always waits.
quests.started: Rassk's coach will take you. Watch well.

steps.journal: Find Scout Feyla on the frozen river, north-east of the Eyrie outpost.
steps.says: A Mirewatch spear? Good, I need one. The Goldfeather raiders carry their eyrie's war-talons. Take three, and they will stay off the river.

steps.journal: Take three war-talons from the Goldfeather raiders round the eyrie east of the Eyrie outpost.
Bring the three war-talons to Scout Feyla.
steps.says: Three talons. The river is quiet. Tell Warden Halvek the watch was kept, then go home.

steps.journal: Tell Warden Halvek at the Eyrie outpost that the watch was kept.
steps.says: Feyla's signal came already. The Mirewatch kept our watch. Go home, hunter, and tell your elder so.

steps.journal: Return to Elder Hsslarn in the Mirewatch.
steps.says: You kept the watch for every home, and came back to ours. The Mirewatch is proud of you, hunter.

choices.says: So be it. It is yours.
So be it. It is yours.

quests.name: A Sprout's Acorn Sash
quests.offer:
Well, well! A new sprout, and not a crumb on you yet. We shall mend that. But first things first: no brownie of the glade goes about without an acorn sash.
Weaver Mossbutton stitches them, up at the north side of the stockade. Tell her I sent you, or she will talk your ears off first.
Will you fetch your sash and show it to me?
quests.declined: No hurry, sprout. The acorns are not going anywhere.
quests.started: Off you trot. North side, by the big leaves. Follow the humming.

steps.journal: Ask Weaver Mossbutton, at the north side of the stockade, for an acorn-cap sash.
steps.says: A new sprout! Arms up. Plaited grass, seven acorn caps, one for luck. There. Not a button to pay, dear. Mind you keep it tidy.

steps.journal: Show the acorn-cap sash to Elder Thimbleroot.
steps.says: Now you look a proper brownie. Keep a crumb tucked in it. You never know when you will want one.

quests.name: Bound to the Glade
quests.offer:
The wide world is full of large feet, sprout. Have Spiritmaster Fennick bind your spirit to the glade, so that you wake here if one of them lands on you.
Then give your name to Coachman Twigg for his ledger. His coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes of the Homelands, for those their stables know.
Will you see them both and come back to me?
quests.declined: Then look up often, sprout. Very often.
quests.started: Fennick is by the west fence. Twigg waits on the grass outside the east gate.

steps.journal: Have Spiritmaster Fennick, by the west fence of the stockade, bind your spirit to the glade.
steps.says: There now. Whatever lands on you, you will wake here among friends, and likely in time for supper. Off to Coachman Twigg with you.

steps.journal: Give your name to Coachman Twigg, outside the east gate, for his ledger.
steps.says: Name in the book, sprout! My coach runs to Freeport and to every other home of the Homelands, for travelers whose names their ledgers hold. Yours is in mine now.

steps.journal: Return to Elder Thimbleroot.
steps.says:
Splendid. Now you can always come home, one way or the other.
Twigg's coach will carry you to Freeport if its ledger knows you, but the road to Rivervale is earned. Hedgewarden Tansy, just north of me, has work for you.

quests.name: Mayflies in the Honey
quests.offer:
So you are the new sprout. Good, I need quick hands. The mayflies are swarming in the hollow south of the stockade, and they are into the honey pots again.
Swat a few swarms and bring me three wings. Then I will show you a trick worth having.
Will you thin them out?
quests.declined: Then it is dry bread for supper, and you may tell Pippkin why.
quests.started: Three wings. Out the east gate and round to the south, down in the hollow.

steps.journal: Take three mayfly wings from the mayfly swarms in the hollow south of the stockade.
Bring three mayfly wings to Hedgewarden Tansy.
steps.says: Three wings, and no honey on your fingers. I am almost surprised. Now watch closely, sprout, and learn this.

quests.name: A Sprout's Arms
quests.offer:
A brownie's wits are sharp, but a wolf does not mind wits. I will make you proper gear, if you fetch what I need.
Weaver Mossbutton has a leather strip and a shaft put by for me. Then take a fang from the glade snakes in the woods west of the stockade.
Will you bring me all three?
quests.declined: Then stay inside the fence, where your wits are enough.
quests.started: Leather and a shaft from Mossbutton, a fang from the snakes. Hop to it.

steps.journal: Ask Weaver Mossbutton for the leather strip and the wooden shaft.
steps.says: For Tansy? Here you are, dear: a strip of leather and a nice straight shaft. Tell her she still has my good needle.

steps.journal: Take a glade snake fang from the glade snakes in the woods west of the stockade.
Bring the leather strip, the wooden shaft and the glade snake fang to Hedgewarden Tansy.
steps.says: All three! A moment... the fang for a point, the leather for a grip. There. It is yours, sprout. Do not poke the grocer with it.

quests.name: Old Greyback
quests.offer:
One thing more before Rivervale has you. An old badger we call Greyback has dug in among the trees far to the north-west. He has dug up two of our gardens and chased the gardeners up a pine.
He is bigger than three of us and cross as a wet cat, so strike first. Bring me his claw, and I will teach you the last trick I have for a sprout.
Will you see to Old Greyback?
quests.declined: He will not grow any sweeter while you wait.
quests.started: North-west, a good long walk through the trees. Mind his claws.

steps.journal: Take Greyback's claw from the badger Old Greyback in the woods far north-west of the stockade.
Bring Greyback's claw to Hedgewarden Tansy.
steps.says:
Greyback's own claw! The gardeners can come down from their pine. You are a sprout no longer.
Learn this, and see Gatekeeper Burrowby at the east gate when you are ready for Rivervale.

quests.name: The Road to Rivervale
quests.offer:
The halflings of Rivervale keep good tables and open doors, and they have always been kind to our kind. Tansy says you are ready for them.
You have earned the road, sprout. I will set you down among your own guild in Rivervale, and your spirit will rest there.
Shall I send you to Rivervale?
quests.declined: Rivervale will keep. Halflings are patient about guests.
quests.started: Mind your manners, and save me a pie!

steps.journal: Tell Gatekeeper Burrowby when you are ready to go to Rivervale.

quests.name: A Quilt for the Winter
quests.offer:
Winter is coming, sprout, and Thimbleroot's old bones feel it. I mean to stitch him a quilt, and only snowfield badger pelts are warm enough.
Ride Twigg's coach to the Goldfeather Eyrie. The badgers dig on the snow east of the hunters' outpost there. Bring me two pelts, nice and thick.
Will you fetch two badger pelts?
quests.declined: Then the elder shivers a little longer.
quests.started: Two pelts. Badgers are Greyback's cousins, and just as cross.

steps.journal: Take two snowfield badger pelts from the badgers on the snow east of the Eyrie outpost.
Bring two snowfield badger pelts to Hedgewarden Tansy in the glade.
steps.says: Oh, they are lovely and warm! The elder will purr like a cat. Now, sprout, a trick for your trouble. Learn this.

quests.name: A Sprout No More
quests.offer:
You have outgrown your little arms, sprout. Time for proper ones. Mossbutton has a leather strip for me, and the Eyrie's quartermaster has iron.
Then bring me two skeins of silk from the rime spiders north-east of the Eyrie outpost. Nothing binds a grip like it.
Will you gather it all?
quests.declined: Then mind you do not break the old ones.
quests.started: Mossbutton first, she is on the way. Then Dunmore, then the spiders.

steps.journal: Ask Weaver Mossbutton at the stockade for Tansy's leather strip.
steps.says: Tansy's strip? Here it is, sprout, and here is a crumb for the road. Do not tell Tansy. She says I spoil you.

steps.journal: Ask Quartermaster Dunmore at the Eyrie outpost for iron ore.
steps.says: A brownie? Tansy's? Well, I owe the glade for that honey cake. Here is your ore. Carry it with both hands.

steps.journal: Take two skeins of silk from the rime spiders north-east of the Eyrie outpost.
Bring the leather strip, the iron ore and the rime spider silk to Hedgewarden Tansy.
steps.says: All of it! Iron for the edge, leather and silk for the grip... there. It is yours, and it is no toy. Do not poke the grocer.

quests.name: Mittens for the Little Ones
quests.offer:
The little sprouts of the glade have cold paws this year, and I have promised them mittens. The softest fur there is grows on the frostpaw cubs.
They play on the snow north of the Eyrie outpost. Bring me three tufts of their fur. Hunt with the other homes: those cubs bite.
Will you fetch three tufts?
quests.declined: Then the little ones blow on their paws a while longer.
quests.started: Three tufts. Mind the cubs. They are bigger than they look.

steps.journal: Take three frostpaw tufts from the frostpaw cubs north of the Eyrie outpost.
Bring three frostpaw tufts to Hedgewarden Tansy.
steps.says: So soft! The little ones will have the warmest paws in the Homelands. You deserve a good trick for this. Learn it.

quests.name: Cold for the Larder
quests.offer:
The Eyrie's quartermaster tells me there is a thing of ice in the caves north-east of his outpost. The Rimeheart, they call it. Ice that never melts!
Dunmore's stores spoil like ours do. Break the Rimeheart and take him a shard, and his larder stays cold all summer. Then come home to me.
Will you face the Rimeheart?
quests.declined: Then the butter melts, and the caves stay cold.
quests.started: Take friends, sprout, and come home in one piece.

steps.journal: Take a shard from the Rimeheart, in the ice caves north-east of the Eyrie outpost.
Bring the shard of the Rimeheart to Quartermaster Dunmore at the Eyrie outpost.
steps.says: Ice that never melts, for my larder? Tansy said a brownie would think of it. Tell her the honey cakes are on me this winter.

steps.journal: Return to Hedgewarden Tansy in the glade.
steps.says: Dunmore's larder is cold and the Rimeheart is broken. You are a hedgewarden in all but name, sprout. Learn this.

quests.name: A Good Neighbor
quests.offer:
Tansy tells me you have kept the whole Eyrie in honey cakes and cold butter. Splendid! A brownie is a good neighbor, sprout, and so are you.
The Eyrie's folk could use a good neighbor now. Ask Quartermaster Dunmore what they need, and help them. Then come home and tell me all.
Will you go and be a good neighbor?
quests.declined: Neighbors keep. Come when you are ready.
quests.started: Twigg's coach will take you. Mind your manners!

steps.journal: Ask Quartermaster Dunmore at the Eyrie outpost what the outpost needs.
steps.says: What do we need? Quiet nights. The raiders keep the warden up. Go and ask Warden Halvek, he will tell you more than I.

steps.journal: Find Warden Halvek at the Eyrie outpost.
steps.says: Dunmore sent you? The Goldfeather raiders round the eyrie east of here steal from our camp. Two of their war-talons would warn them off.

steps.journal: Take two war-talons from the Goldfeather raiders round the eyrie east of the Eyrie outpost.
Bring the two war-talons to Warden Halvek.
steps.says: Two talons. They will think twice about our camp now. The glade raises good neighbors. Go home and tell your elder so.

steps.journal: Return to Elder Thimbleroot in the glade.
steps.says: Halvek's thanks came by the coach, and a honey cake with it. You went out a sprout and came home a neighbor to every home. Use it well, dear.

choices.says: A fine choice, dear. It is yours.
A fine choice, dear. It is yours.

quests.name: The Heart Without a Laugh
quests.offer:
They say the Rimeheart in the ice caves north-east of the Eyrie outpost is a heart that never laughed, and the cold it makes is the cold of that.
Break it, little friend. Carry a shard to Warden Halvek so his outpost knows, and then come back and tell me how it went.
Will you break the Rimeheart?
quests.declined: Then the caves stay cold, and no one laughs.
quests.started: Go with friends, and go warm.

steps.journal: Take a shard from the Rimeheart, in the ice caves north-east of the Eyrie outpost.
Bring the shard of the Rimeheart to Warden Halvek at the Eyrie outpost.
steps.says: A fairy broke the Rimeheart. Ha! I will never hear the end of it from the other homes. Tell Larkspur the Eyrie thanks the valley.

steps.journal: Return to Warden Larkspur.
steps.says: Halvek laughed? Halvek! Then you did two great things today. Learn this, little friend, the last I have.

Larkspur says you made the Eyrie's warden laugh, and broke its coldest heart. You are no new fairy now, little friend. You are a fairy of the Homelands.

Will you go back to the Eyrie?
quests.declined: Then rest, and come when the wind is right.

steps.journal: Return to Elder Moonpetal in the valley.

quests.name: A Shape for Qeynos
quests.offer:
In Qeynos the humans will take you for one of their own, so long as your armour holds its shape around you. They train any who come in good faith.
You have earned the way, bright one. I will set you down among your own guild there, and your light will rest in Qeynos.
Shall I send you to Qeynos?
quests.declined: The swamp will hold your light a while longer.
quests.started: Burn bright, and keep your helm on!

steps.journal: Tell Gatekeeper Dimlight when you are ready to go to Qeynos.

quests.notes: Ours: the gatekeeper's port to Qeynos, the wisp's wire race's city, each class to its own guild's spot there (teleport to mainland: the wire race's start row for the class), bound there: the passage the five starter quests earn (a coach runs between the home and Freeport for anyone). Repeatable, so one back in the homeland is sent again; no reward, so none is had twice. Written by tools/quests/gen_homelands.py from tools/quests/homelands/wisp.json.

items.name: young giant's tooth thong
items.description: A rhino's tooth on a thong of thick hide. Every young giant of the West Plateau camp wears one.

items.name: plateau skink scale
items.description: A scale of a plateau skink from the plain west of the giants' camp.

items.name: rock badger claw

items.name: Greyjaw's fang
items.description: A yellowed fang of the old wolf Greyjaw of the West Plateau.

items.name: cub's claw band

items.name: isle crab claw
items.description: The claw of an isle crab from the sand spit north of the kerrans' village.

items.name: fern viper fang
items.description: The fang of a fern viper from the ferns west of the kerrans' village.

items.name: Old Snapclaw's claw
items.description: The great notched claw of the crab Old Snapclaw of Kerra Isle.

items.name: river-shell charm
items.description: A chip of river shell on a reed cord. Every young kappa of the Dwell wears one.

items.name: marsh rat tail

items.name: braided reed cord
items.description: A length of river reed, braided tight by the Dwell's netmenders.

items.name: mudfang scale
items.description: A broad scale from a mudfang basilisk of the flats south of the Dwell's shore.

items.name: Gulpjaw's tooth
items.description: A long tooth of the blue basilisk Gulpjaw.

items.name: pup's digging sash
items.description: A sash of tunnel-rat hide, knotted in clan Kolbok's way. Every pup of the Warrens wears one.

items.name: tunnel beetle horn
items.description: The horn of a tunnel beetle from the west end of the Warrens.

items.name: rat-hide lacing
items.description: A long lace cut from tunnel-rat hide by the Warrens' stitchers.

items.name: deepway millipede leg
items.description: A hard, jointed leg from a deepway millipede of the Warrens' south tunnels.

items.name: Gravelmaw's mandible
items.description: A notched mandible of the scythe beetle Gravelmaw.

items.name: tideline ring
items.description: A ring of twisted wire scavenged from the tide line. Every young ratman of the shore camp wears one.

items.name: dune snake fang
items.description: The fang of a dune snake from the sand east of the ratmen's shore camp.

items.name: salvaged net cord
items.description: A length of tarred cord picked out of a net the tide left on the ratmen's shore.

items.name: tidewrack crab claw
items.description: The heavy claw of a tidewrack crab from the tide line by the ratmen's shore camp.

items.name: Hoodscale's fang
items.description: A long, hollow fang of the cobra Hoodscale.

items.name: reveler's bangle
items.description: A bangle of carved vine-wood that clicks in time when its wearer dances. Every young satyr of the glade wears one.

items.name: glade spiderling leg
items.description: The leg of a glade spiderling from the grass east of the satyrs' glade.

items.name: twisted vine cord
items.description: A cord of green vine, twisted tight by the reedcutters of the satyrs' glade.

items.name: mead wasp stinger
items.description: The stinger of a mead wasp from the woods south-east of the satyrs' glade.

items.name: Nightpelt's fang
items.description: A long fang of the shadow panther Nightpelt.

items.name: acorn-cap earring
items.description: The cap of an acorn from the grove's first oak, hung on a thread of bark. Every young dryad of the grove wears one.

items.name: bark beetle shell
items.description: The shell of a bark beetle from the woods west of the dryads' lake.

items.name: willow-bark cord
items.description: A cord of willow bark, peeled and twisted by the weavers of the dryads' grove.

items.name: rootcoil snake skin
items.description: The mottled skin of a rootcoil snake from the deep woods west of the dryads' lake.

items.name: Rotbark's heartwood
items.description: A knot of blackened heartwood from the rotting shambler Rotbark.

items.name: stonewake band
items.description: A band of crag-lizard hide set with a chip of the roost's own rock. Every newly woken gargoyle of the crag wears one.

items.name: crag bat wing
items.description: The leathery wing of a crag bat from the foot of the gargoyles' crag.

items.name: crag-hide thong
items.description: A thong cut from crag-lizard hide by the hidecutters of the gargoyles' roost.

items.name: cragside skink tail
items.description: The thick tail of a cragside skink from the barrens east of the gargoyles' crag.

items.name: Grindstone's core
items.description: The hard knot of rock at the heart of the sand-thing Grindstone.

items.name: novice's prayer beads
items.description: A string of grey stone beads from the temple of Envar. A novice of the Jal'Raeth counts its breaths on them.

items.name: ash grub tooth
items.description: The tooth of an ash grub from the dead hills east of Envar.

items.name: cinder adder fang
items.description: The fang of a cinder adder from the low hills north-east of Envar.

items.name: Hollow Pilgrim's bone
items.description: A brittle bone of the Hollow Pilgrim, to be laid back in the crypt of Envar.

items.name: fledgling's wingband
items.description: A band of knotted reed and down. Every fledgling of the Roost wears one on its wing.

items.name: scrub rat tail
items.description: The tail of a scrub rat from the grass north of the Roost.

items.name: brush wasp stinger
items.description: The stinger of a brush wasp from the hill west of the Roost.

items.name: Razortusk's tusk
items.description: The chipped tusk of the old boar Razortusk.

items.name: drift rat fur
items.description: A clump of white fur from a drift rat of the Goldfeather Eyrie's snow.

items.name: snowfield badger pelt
items.description: The thick pelt of a snowfield badger of the Goldfeather Eyrie.

items.name: rime spider silk
items.description: A skein of frosted silk from a rime spider of the Goldfeather Eyrie.

items.name: shard of the Rimeheart
items.description: A shard of blue ice that never melts, broken from the Rimeheart.

items.name: Goldfeather war-talon
items.description: A war-talon of the Goldfeather aviaks, bound in gold thread.

items.name: tunnel-runner's ear ring
items.description: A ring of rat bone and wire. Every goblin of Moss Mouth Cavern wears one, so the lookouts know it in the dark.

items.name: tunnel rat tail
items.description: The tail of a tunnel rat from the long tunnel of Moss Mouth Cavern.

items.name: cave bat wing
items.description: The leathery wing of a cave bat from the north-east chamber of Moss Mouth Cavern.

items.name: Mossweb's fang
items.description: The long black fang of the spider Mother Mossweb.

items.name: Old Frostjaw's pelt
items.description: The scarred grey pelt of Old Frostjaw, the snow leopard of the Eyrie's slopes.

items.name: hatchling's fang cord
items.description: A cord of swamp reed strung with a young gator's fang. Every hatchling of the Mirewatch wears one at its throat.

items.name: bog beetle shell
items.description: The green-black shell of a bog beetle from the south shore of the temple island.

items.name: marsh serpent fang
items.description: The curved fang of a marsh serpent from the east island of Cazic-Thule.

items.name: Snapjaw's tooth
items.description: A yellowed tooth, long as a hand, from the old alligator Snapjaw.

items.name: pale owl pinion
items.description: A long white flight feather from a pale owl of the Goldfeather Eyrie.

items.name: acorn-cap sash
items.description: A sash of plaited grass sewn with acorn caps. Every brownie of Mayfly Glade wears one, and keeps a crumb or two tucked in it.

items.name: mayfly wing
items.description: A glassy wing from a mayfly swarm of the hollow south of the stockade.

items.name: glade snake fang
items.description: The thin fang of a glade snake from the woods west of the stockade.

items.name: Greyback's claw
items.description: A blunt grey claw, as long as a brownie's arm, from the badger Old Greyback.

items.name: frostpaw tuft
items.description: A tuft of thick white fur from a frostpaw cub of the Goldfeather Eyrie.

items.name: dewdrop ring
items.description: A ring of spider silk holding one drop of morning dew that never dries. Every pixie of the Misty Thicket wears one.

items.name: bramble rat tail
items.description: The tail of a bramble rat from the brambles south-west of the pines.

items.name: thicket beetle shell
items.description: The glossy shell of a thicket beetle from the low ground east of the pines.

items.name: Redsting's stinger
items.description: The barbed red stinger of the hornet Redsting, as long as a pixie's arm.

items.name: drift rat whisker

items.name: moonpetal bracelet

items.name: dusk beetle eye

items.name: valley raven feather
items.description: A glossy black tail feather from a raven of the valley of the Twisted Tower.

items.name: Cindersnap's scale
items.description: A warm, ember-coloured scale from the young drake Cindersnap.

items.name: snowfield badger claw
items.description: A blunt digging claw from a snowfield badger of the Goldfeather Eyrie.

items.name: moonpetal thread

items.name: Old Frostjaw's claw

items.name: ridge viper fang

items.name: Greymuzzle's fang

items.name: Thedruk war band

items.name: camp rat tail

items.name: scree spider leg

items.name: Scarback's claw

items.name: mine rat tail

items.name: ore beetle shell

items.name: Gorespine's spine

items.name: sprout's root sash

items.name: bog rat tail
items.description: The tail of a bog rat from the reeds of the West Feerrott.

items.name: Duskpaw's fang
items.description: A fang of the young jaguar Duskpaw, who hunted the lights of the West Feerrott.
